_comment: Template: RDF format conversion (single file or multi-file union).
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Fill in the paths. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar convert --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: Use to convert between RDF/XML (.rdf/.xml), Turtle (.ttl), and JSON-LD (.jsonld). Supports merging multiple input files into one output graph (modelUnion mode).
_input_note: Use 'input' for a single source file, OR 'inputFiles' for multiple files to union. Not both.
_note_output: Extension determines the default target format: .ttl → Turtle, .jsonld → JSON-LD, .rdf/.xml → RDF/XML. Override with 'targetFormat'.
_note_sourceFormat: RDFXML, TURTLE, or JSONLD. Leave empty for auto-detection from input extension.
_note_targetFormat: RDFXML, TURTLE, or JSONLD. Leave empty for auto-detection from output extension.
_note_xmlBase: Base URI used when reading/writing RDF/XML. Empty string is the default. For CGMES profiles use 'http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100'.
_note_rdfFormat: RDF/XML sub-format: RDFXML_PLAIN (default), RDFXML_ABBREV, RDFXML_PRETTY, CIMXML (CIM-optimised plain/pretty), RDFS_CIMXML (CIM-optimised plain). Only applies when target format is RDF/XML.
_note_sortByPrefix: Sort by namespace prefix. Only meaningful when 'sort' is true.
_note_stripPrefixes: Remove namespace prefix declarations from the output.
